thread:
ops-bot: [ALERT] Synthetic probe 'svc-text-gen-eu/canary' firing - 120 alerts in 5m across eu-west-1 (severity: P3)

maria.g: seeing it, getting paged. looks like a probe storm not real errors?

jonathan_y: checking metrics — backend 5xx not elevated, latency okay. probe success rate dropped because TL;DR: model returned empty token 10% of time for short sequences.

ash: timeline? when did it start?

maria.g: started ~1978701200 (roughly ~20m ago), ramped up at 1978701900. Alerts triggered by synthetic failure threshold (success_rate < 0.95) with 1m eval window.

sam: are customers impacted? any active p99 errors for requests?

jonathan_y: quick check: customer traffic p95/p99 flat. No increase in errors. It looks like the canary probe pattern changed (maybe model warms differently after deploy).

ops-bot: Deploy bot: New model variant 'open-l7-hotfix' rolled to staging at 1978698000, promoted to canary pool at 1978701000.

maria.g: ok so root cause likely canary model variant producing occasional zero-length outputs on short prompts; probes rippled into page noise. Not a customer-facing outage.

ash: proposal: reduce probe frequency from 30s -> 180s for short prompt check, widen the success_rate threshold to 0.90 for 1h, and add a short debounce so we don't page on transient blips.

sam: agree on temp relax. Also add a dedicated dashboard panel for "canary output length distribution" to visualize.

jonathan_y: concrete changes I'll make now:
```
# canary config snippet
probe.svc: svc-text-gen-eu
probe.interval: 180s
probe.window: 5m
probe.success_threshold: 0.90
probe.debounce: 3 # require 3 consecutive failed windows
```

jonathan_y: I'll also create a grafana panel under /dashboards/infra/canary-text-gen-eu with a 1m series for output_length and failure_rate.

maria.g: can we also add a targeted alert rule (no page) for 6m sustained failure >15% to catch real regressions? keep paging reserved for customer-impacting signals.

ash: +1. temporary policy: synthetic failures -> non-pager severity unless accompanied by backend 5xx or customer latency regressed. we'll document in incident runbook.

ops-bot: action_taken: probe config updated by jonathan_y at 1978703100. Pager suppression set to non-pager for this probe group.

sam: handoff for overnight: if failure_rate > 0.25 for 10 min and any backend 5xx >1% escalate to P1. Otherwise monitor. Oncall: @maria.g -> @jonathan_y will own follow-ups tomorrow.

maria.g: noted. I'll draft a postmortem-ish summary and the dashboard link.

jonathan_y: follow-ups (tracked):
- revert probe interval after canary stable (ticket INFRA-4321)
- add unit test to probe harness for zero-length outputs (PR #3456)
- document paging thresholds in runbook: /runbooks/canary-monitoring

ash: good. also add a short blameless note to the #incidents channel so product/support know it was probe noise.

sam: thanks all. closing the noisy pages. I'll update PD escalation rules later tonight. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident closed (no customer impact) by maria.g at 1978703920

maria.g: TL;DR: noisy synthetic probe after canary variant rollout caused many alerts, no customer impact. mitigations applied: lowered probe sensitivity, increased interval, added debounce; dashboards & runbook updates planned.
